title: Launching our private beta for Algorova(India)
author: theRaxar0420
selftext:
Hello everyone,

We are launching our private beta for Algorova and we will accept testers in batches.

Top features-

AI startegy maker- Plain english strategy maker, currently limited to options. Say in absolute basic terms like I have this much money and low risk apetite and it will start from there and build you the entire strategy as well as the fields.

Multi AI backtest- Same plain english, you can try saying something like try different stop loss and profit target andthe AI will create 5-10(limited to this now) combinations of the same strategy. Our backtesting engine will run all of them and show u results side by side.

Audit AI(very early version)- Shows why each trade was taken, will probably evolve into something different over time.

How to join: Go to algorova.com and click early beta private access and fill your name, email and what broker. Thats it.

Fouder cred- Managed 10cr for a firm, worked in micro VC, Nism 8.  Going for nism 15 and then Sebi RA.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the multi backtest is the feature I would watch most carefully. run 5 to 10 stop and target combinations side by side and the best of them is whichever got lucky on that stretch, and a beginner will pick it every time. showing the spread of all ten next to the winner, or holding out the last few months and grading the pick there, would make it honest. what are the options fills built from, NSE ticks or bar closes?
